query: SELECT e.sender_user_id, count(*) AS "sent!", count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 'completed') AS "completed!" FROM envelopes AS e WHERE e.account_id = $1 AND e.deleted_at IS NULL AND e.sent_at IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM envelope_states AS s WHERE s.account_id = e.account_id AND s.envelope_id = e.id) AND e.created_at >= $2 AND e.created_at < $3 AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR e.sender_user_id = $4) GROUP BY e.sender_user_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC, e.sender_user_id LIMIT $5
